Maya: Quick one — caption the ficus on the kitchen counter. one-line only. winner gets a cookie 🍪 and eternal admiration :sparkles:
Sam: "Photosynthesizes under pressure." dibs.
Kevin: "Silent coworker, loud leaves." love that one lol
Anita: "Office oxygen supplier, part-time therapist." :herb:
Maya: Voting time — reply with a :thumbsup: for your fav
Sam: :thumbsup: for Kevin
Kevin: Thanks! also +1 for Anita
Anita: Accepting bribes (coffee) :coffee:
Deploy-bot: heads-up: please don't feed the ficus before 10am. watering schedule updated in `#plants`
Maya: 😂 noted. also huge kudos to @Anita for rescuing the succulent last week :clap:
Sam: big kudos :heart_eyes:
Kevin: Cookie stake acknowledged — who will bake? :raising_hand:
Anita: I can bring biscotti Friday (not a real emoji, but imagine it)
Maya: Poll: biscotti or choc chip? react :biscotti: or :cookie:
Sam: voting choc chip -> :cookie:
Kevin: biscotti for the vibes :biscotti:
Maya: Results: 2 biscotti, 1 choc chip. biscotti Friday. @KitchenTeam heads up :wave:
Sam: victory lap :tada:
Anita: also — micro-haiku challenge tomorrow at noon. 3 lines, 5/7/5. prize: bragging rights.
Kevin: i'll bring a haiku and my a-game :muscle:
Maya: perfect. thread semi-closed — thanks for the quick smiles, team :smile:
